Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: England
Analyst: Pete Grogan
Date: 03/12/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 499 as introduced proposes a Constitutional Amendment which, if ratified, would establish the 9-member Alabama Court Cost Commission to review existing laws regarding court costs and proposals for new court costs. This would increase obligations of the Commission, presumably funded by the State General Fund, by an estimated $2,200 per day for each meeting of the Commission.
This bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary

Committee: Judiciary
Sponsor: England

Date: 03/31/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 499 as amended and reported by the Committee on Judiciary proposes a Constitutional Amendment which, if ratified, would establish the 11-member Alabama Court Cost Commission to review existing laws regarding court costs and proposals for new court costs. This would increase obligations of the Commission, presumably funded by the State General Fund, by an estimated $2,800 per day for each meeting of the Commission.
This bill will increase the proclamation expenses of the Governor, paid from the State General Fund, by an estimated $100,000 for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2023.
Jim Hill, Chair
Judiciary
